title: fix(security): Enforce per-server oauth_enabled on MCP endpoints
reasoning:
## Summary

- Enforce the per-server `oauth_enabled` flag on MCP transport endpoints, closing the gap where OAuth was advertised (via RFC 9728) but never enforced
- Unauthenticated requests to `oauth_enabled` servers now receive 401 regardless of the global `MCP_REQUIRE_AUTH` setting
- Defense-in-depth checks added to all six MCP handlers (`list_tools`, `call_tool`, `list_prompts`, `get_prompt`, `list_resources`, `read_resource`)
- Fix DAR202 lint warning in `set_log_level` docstring

Closes #3304

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify unauthenticated requests to `oauth_enabled=True` servers return 401 in permissive mode
- [ ] Verify unauthenticated requests to `oauth_enabled=False` servers still pass through in permissive mode
- [ ] Verify authenticated requests to `oauth_enabled=True` servers work normally
- [ ] Verify DB lookup failures in OAuth enforcement fail-open (preserve permissive mode)
- [ ] Verify all existing unit tests pass with no regressions (290 transport tests, 12,795 total unit
